# Text engine (recon, phase 1)

ROM: LoROM, 1.5 MB (header size byte says 2 MB), no SRAM. Header checksum 9F12/60ED.
No earlier fan translation found (web search, Oct 2026). Most menus/HUD are already English graphics.

## Encoding (tbl/jp.tbl, tbl/en.tbl; generated by tools/mktbl.py)
- One code = one 8x16 glyph (2bpp, two 8x8 tiles: top 2c, bottom 2c+1). Font at file 0x88000 ($91:8000), 224 glyphs.
- 00 end, 01 new line (+2 tile rows). 02-60 = ASCII - 0x1E (space 02, '0' 12, 'A' 23, 'a' 43).
- 43-5C (a-z) are blank/garbage in the original font: our font patch draws lowercase there.
- Kana: 61。 62「 63」 64、 65・ 66ー 67゛ 68゜ 69ヲ 6A-72 small katakana, 73-9F katakana ア..ワン (no ヲ),
  A0 を, A1-A9 small hiragana, AA-D6 hiragana あ..わん. Dakuten/handakuten are separate cells AFTER the kana.
- Glyph style: italic, 1-px skeleton (colour 1 top half, 2 bottom half) + 8-neighbour outline (colour 3).

## Printer task $80:B688 (spawn: LDA #$B688/STA $40, LDA #$80/STA $42, JSL $80AA97, then fields on the new task Y)
- $1C mode: 0 = write tilemap entries code*2+attr (VRAM inc 32: 8x16 cell), 1 = DMA glyph tiles from $91 to
  tile (attr & 3FF) and up, 2 = other. $1E VRAM tilemap word address, $20 attr/tile base, $22 per-char delay,
  $24/$26 text pointer. Task structs live at $7E:4900.. (X = task, DBR $7E).
- `tools/lua/printlog.lua` logs every string/line it prints (runtime leftover scan).
- `tools/find_printer_calls.py` lists every static spawn and its params.

## Text groups (tools/textdefs.py; refs rewritten by build.py)
| group | region | refs | where shown |
|---|---|---|---|
| credits | 2DEAE-2ED52 (EN roll + JP "true ending" roll) | imm 2DDA6 / 2DDB4 ($1022==4 picks JP) | ending, VRAM $1BC3 col 3 |
| debug | 2F16F-2F1D6 | table 2F159 x11, imms 2EE3F 2EE72 | hidden debug menu (task $85:ED52, never spawned) |
| bonus | 2F693-2F6EA | table 2F67D x11, imms 2F2CE 2F301 | OPTION after the mode-select code ($10AC=1) |
| names | 12381-12499 (40 x 7 bytes) | table 12331 x40 (LDA $82A331,x) | match HUD, mode 1, 8-char slots (tiles 1E0/1F0) |
| endmsg | DE20A-DE250 | imm DE150, bank imm DE156 | after the normal ending |
| quotes | DED6B-DF0DE | table DED2F x30, bank imm DEBE7 | tour-win / ending quotes, VRAM $1A45 |
| story | DF42F-DF5FA | table DF3E7 x36, bank imm DF343 | intro crawl, VRAM $0628 (16 cols) |
| profiles | DFA1C-DFE17 | table DF9F2 x21, bank imm DF919 | team/character profiles, VRAM $08EE |

Bank-$1B groups are relocated to bank $8F free space (file 7E18D-7FFFF) by changing the bank immediate.
Free space: bank 02 17C4C-17FFF, bank 05 2F77A-2FFFF, bank 0F 7E18D-7FFFF.

## Secrets
- Mode-select code (17 presses, table $89:901A): Up Left Down Right B Right Down Left Up Y Left Right Up Down Y
  Select Start -> $10AC=1 -> OPTION opens the bonus mode.
- Debug menu task $85:ED52 is unreferenced; the debug tool forces it.
- $1022 = CPU level; 4 gives the Japanese staff roll.
